risk.rationale: No surviving verified findings remain for prof.kaya@aegean.edu. Every alert chain was rejected by critic review with a documented explanation: the TR/Portugal sign-ins are non-interactive ExchangeSync/15 mail-sync tokens plus legitimate VPN sign-ins from managed device LT-3104 (not impossible travel or token replay); Turkcell/193.140.10.21 is the organisation's shared egress (202 distinct accounts MFA'd from it in 30 days, above the 10 threshold), so the single ASN event and the 54-account/60-failure spray pattern are background noise, not a coordinated attack; vpn-edge-02 firmware 22.7R2.8 includes the version-checkable KEV fixes, and vpn-edge-01 never carried a sign-in for this account so its KEV listing is not this account's exposure. There are no data-quality conflicts. All suspicious signals are explained away, with no confirmed account-takeover chain, no weak unexplained signal, and no exposure needing human review.
